versions.short: The bill would require the Small Business Administration to set up procedures within 180 days so that its disaster loan outreach materials, such as press releases and fact sheets, consistently include accurate and up-to-date information about the disaster loan program, related changes to federal disaster assistance eligibility, and any other details the agency decides to add. The procedures would include standard templates, a check that materials use current templates and terms before they are released, and an annual review of consistency across the agency's disaster field offices, with a review also required after any significant changes. The agency would also have to notify the House and Senate small business committees within 30 days of creating or significantly changing these procedures.
